QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Hammer
QuestInfo.0: #p203# of #m10001000# seems to have another request.
QuestInfo.1: #p203# of #m10001000# asked me to look for the #b#t4031116##k for #p202#. Will I be able to find it while hunting #b#o23##k deep inside the Ant Tunnel? Nothing is certain, but if I ever get the chance to go to the Ant Tunnel, I should look for it. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I hunted #o23# deep inside the Ant Tunnel and finally found the #t4031116#. I thought it couldn't be found since it was lost decades ago... By the way, #p202# really must have been an adventurer in the past.

0.0: I see. #p205#'s story sounds plausible. After all, he probably never imagined he could find the weapon he lost back when he dreamed of being an adventurer. But if someone like me were to go to such a dangerous place... Would you be able to look for the #b#t4031116##k if you happen to explore the Ant Tunnel?

yes.0: Thank you! If it's a cave teeming with #o23#, it has to be deep inside the Ant Tunnel near #m10005000#. Don't you think we might find it while hunting those monsters? Though I'm not sure if it can still be found after several decades have passed. I'm counting on you!

no.0: Even as a neighbor, asking a favor like this must be too much, I suppose.

1.0: You're back! I can't believe you actually found the #t4031116#. #p202# really must have been an adventurer in his youth. I'm already looking forward to seeing how happy he'll be when he sees this.

item.0: According to #p205#, #p202# lost his weapon in a cave teeming with #o23# back when he was an adventurer. I'd like you to go look for it. Though the chances of it still being there after decades are pretty low...
